app_identity.name: Mikilab — Il Laboratorio di Michele
app_identity.tagline: Ricettario artigianale & Capo Laboratorio intelligente (Matera ➔ Stoccarda)

design_archetype.name: Artisan Bakery + Bilingual IT/DE Heritage Fusion
design_archetype.description: Blends authentic warm wood-fired bakery textures (flour cream #FDFBF7, terracotta #B34A26, golden crust #D99B26) with bold, high-contrast Italian (Verde Italia #008C45, Rosso Italia #CD212A) and German (Schwarz #111111, Rot Deutschland #DD0000, Gold Deutschland #FFCC00) visual accents woven into cards, buttons, badges, dividers, navigation states, and dark-mode themes.

italian_palette.usage: Used for Italian origin badges, Matera/Puglia sourdough indicators, dough freshness scores, IT language active states, and left-side card accent borders.

german_palette.usage: Used for Stuttgart local flour guides, German oven adaptation tools, DE language active states, temperature alerts, and right-side card accent badges.

sections_and_functionalities.mikilab: Recipe book list & detail modals, cost calculation per piece, flour ratios, step-by-step instructions.
sections_and_functionalities.maestro: Capo Laboratorio production planner, Termostato & Clima, Panettone printable labels, add recipe, weekly plan, adapt oven, sourdough refresh, beginners.
sections_and_functionalities.photo_diagnosi: AI photo analysis for dough defects, ingredients, and tool recognition.
sections_and_functionalities.maestro_sa_tutto: AI Maestro chat ('Chiedi e ti sarà dato'), encyclopedia IT/DE farine, YouTube technique videos, Stuttgart local announcements.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All buttons, inputs, tabs, modals, and switches MUST maintain kebab-case data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure Italian (green/white/red) and German (black/red/gold) colors are visibly integrated throughout card borders, badges, dividers, button highlights, and status indicators without removing the warm bakery terracotta identity.
Do NOT alter or remove any existing data-testid attributes across components.
Maintain high contrast (WCAG AA) for all text against backgrounds in both light and dark modes.
Ensure all interactive touch targets on mobile maintain a minimum height of 44px-48px.
Preserve full dark-mode support using Tailwind dark: modifiers and CSS variables.
